_comment_overrides: Both entries force a patched transitive dependency that next pins below the fix, where npm's only offered remedy is the next@16 major. sharp: an OPTIONAL dependency of next (^0.34.3) used solely for next/image optimization; 0.34.x carries four libvips CVEs, and this app imports no next/image. postcss: next bundles its own nested copy, so bumping our direct dependency alone left the vulnerable one in place. Re-check both on every next upgrade and delete whichever the new range already satisfies — a stale override silently pins a dependency backwards.
